{{Quote|You'll be taking your personal shuttle, I presume.''"<br />"''That's right. The ''Victory'' over in hangar thirteen.|Chet and Zannah|<ref name="Doe" />}}
The '''''Victory''''' was a [[Theta-class T-1 vessel|''Theta''-class T-1 vessel]] used by [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]. She flew in the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] on multiple occasions, including on [[Mission to Doan|her first mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]]. After finding and [[Duel in Set Harth's mansion|recruiting]] the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] as her potential apprentice, she traveled in the ''Victory'' again to Doan, where she [[Duel on Doan|confronted]] her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. The duel ended in a draw, and Zannah was forced to flee the planet in her [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Shortly after, she received a message in the ''Victory'' from Bane to come to [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] and face him in a [[Duel on Ambria (980 BBY)|final duel]] for the title of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], which Zannah won.

==Description==
{{Quote|Oh, yeah. I remember him. Nice ride. State-of-the-art shuttle. Custom interior. Top of the line. Even nicer than yours.|Pommat, comparing Set Harth's shuttle to Zannah's|<ref name="Doe" />}}
The ''Victory'' was a [[Theta-class T-1 vessel|''Theta''-class T-1 vessel]] that was manufactured by [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]]. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], required only one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and could carry at least one additional passenger. The shuttle was also outfitted with a private [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] channel.<ref name="Doe" />

==History==
{{Quote|Ambria. The healer's camp.|Darth Bane's coded message to Zannah in the ''Victory''|<ref name="Doe" />}}
The ''Victory'' was the personal shuttle of [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[New Sith Wars]]. She based her operations out of a [[Darth Bane's mansion|mansion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ciutric IV]], where she lived with her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. While on Ciutric IV, Zannah kept the ''Victory'' at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Daplona]], where it was commonly attended by the customs [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Chet]], who knew Zannah and Bane as "Allia Omek" and "Sepp Omek," respectively. She flew in the shuttle on several operations, including [[Mission to Doan|her first mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]], where she was sent by Bane in [[980 BBY]].<ref name="Doe" />

[[File:DarthZannah-DoE.png|thumb|right|125px|Darth Zannah, owner of the ''Victory'']]
On Doan, Zannah began to track down the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]]. Her search led her to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Pommat]], from whom she gained information about Harth. Pommat also revealed the details of his business to Zannah&mdash;he broke into unsuspecting travelers' [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and hid shipments of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in them, which were later secretly picked up by one of his contacts at the ship's [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] port. When Zannah inquired as to whether or not Pommat had left such a shipment of spice on the ''Victory'', he revealed that he had not done so, as hers was the first ship to come from Ciutric IV and he did not yet have any contacts on that world. This prompted Zannah to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him, as she could not risk allowing him to live with the knowledge of where she and Bane lived.<ref name="Doe" />

Zannah then tracked Harth to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], where she [[Duel in Set Harth's mansion|confronted]] him and convinced him to join her as her apprentice in preparation for her upcoming confrontation with Bane. They flew in the ''Victory'' back to Bane and Zannah's home on Ciutric IV, only to find that her Master had been [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|captured]] by the [[Doan Royal Guard]]. The two traveled in the vessel to Doan, where they tracked Bane to the underground [[Stone Prison]]. Zannah ordered Harth to stay behind and guard the ''Victory'' while she entered the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] to hunt down her Master; however, Harth soon grew bored and left his post. Soon after, he found the [[Holocron of Heresies|legendary holocron]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Andeddu]] and fled the planet in a different vessel. Meanwhile, Zannah found and [[Duel on Doan|confronted]] her Master, but [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] of Doan, hoping to kill both Sith Lords, set the prison to [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]]. The duel ended in a draw, and Zannah arrived at the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] to find that Harth had left. She then quickly fled in the ''Victory'' to escape the collapsing prison.<ref name="Doe" />

Zannah decided then that she would travel [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in her shuttle in search of Bane, in order to hunt him down and wrest from him the title of Dark Lord of the Sith. Before long, however, she received a distress call on the ''Victory''{{'s}} private comm channel&mdash;a channel which only she and Bane knew&mdash;instructing her to come to a [[Caleb's hut|hut]] on the planet [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] for one final confrontation. She flew the ''Victory'' to the appointed location, where she [[Duel on Ambria (980 BBY)|dueled]] and defeated Bane before taking on the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Darth Cognus]] as her new apprentice.<ref name="Doe" />

==Commanders and crew==
{{Quote|I'm going in alone. You're going to stay here and guard the ship.|Darth Zannah, to Harth|<ref name="Doe" />}}
The ''Victory'' was owned and operated by Sith apprentice Darth Zannah around 980 BBY. For a brief time, the Dark Jedi Set Harth flew with Zannah in the ''Victory''; however, after finding Andeddu's holocron in the Stone Prison, he fled the planet in a different ship.<ref name="Doe" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Victory'' appeared in ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', the final novel of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']] released [[December 8]], [[2009]].
